_comment: Curated backend topology that can't be auto-derived from the clone/scan/inventory pipeline. Edited via the in-app Admin panel (dev: writes here; read-only deploys: copy/paste the JSON). assemble.mjs reads this into data.backendTopology; graph.js merges it with the live backend scan (data.extras.backends.scanned) so newly-cloned backends still appear. desc/tooling are FALLBACKS only — the live GitHub description and build-file scan win when present. host is the API origin; invName/invAlias bridge a node to its Component Inventory entry (and to integrations.csv rows, which are keyed by inventory name). deployTarget links a backend to a deploy-target node (config.json `deployTargets`) on the Deployments layer. serviceEdges are curated node-to-node service relationships (drawn when both endpoints are on the map; endpoints are node ids — repo folders or backend ids). contentRepos are repo-less content sources drawn next to their parent card.
_frameworkDeps: Curated internal frameworks the backends build on: backend-scan.mjs looks for these Maven group ids in every scanned repo's build files and records the artifacts + version (from `versionProp` in gradle.properties, else the coordinate literal). assemble.mjs turns the hits into frameworkConsumers — the backend counterpart of uiConsumers.

restHostAliases._comment: Internal-only aliases for the code-derived REST matcher (assemble.mjs): maps an outbound URL token (a host head, or a gateway path segment like gateway/<service>) to the canonical component when it isn't the component's own name. Third-party hosts live in third-party-meta.csv (Hosts column) instead.
